set.body: Extend spatial CoordinateMap and ImageMorphismBridge beyond identity and affine transforms to executable dense-field and displacement-field pullbacks with explicit interpolation, boundary, and inverse policies. Compose coordinate maps first and sample root data only at the end. Acceptance: dense maps participate in route lowering and cache fingerprints; missing or approximate inverses remain explicit; affine-equivalent dense fixtures match the affine path; independent nonlinear coordinate fixtures validate convention and direction; shared tests pass on JVM and JS.
set.title: Spatial nonlinear pullbacks: executable dense and displacement coordinate maps
